'''''Aristolochia pistolochia''''' is a [[herbaceous]] plant in the family [[Aristolochiaceae]] endemic to [[Mediterranean Basin|Mediterranean]] areas across southwest [[Europe]].

==Description==
[[File:(Pistolochia Osterluzei (Aristolochia pistolochia L.).jpg|thumb|left]]
''Aristolochia paucinervis'' is a perennial [[geophyte]] plant. Its [[rhizome]] is formed by numerous cylindrical [[tubers]]. Leaves are ovate-triangular, sharp to marginalized with cartilaginous margins, with a [[glaucous]] underside and very marked nerves. Flowers are yellow on the outside and dark reddish or green on the inside.<ref name="iberica">{{cite web |title=Aristolochia pistolochia |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/01_033_01_Aristolochia.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref> It is similar to ''[[Aristolochia paucinervis]]'', but can be easily distinguished by its thick, jagged leaf border.<ref>{{cite web |title=Distinction between A. pistolochia and A. paucinervis |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/d55 |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
''Aristolochia pistolochia'' is distributed throughout southwestern Europe, including the [[Iberian Peninsula]] (in [[Portugal]] and [[Spain]]), southern [[France]], [[Corsica]] and [[Sardinia]]. It inhabits clearings of bushes, [[heaths]] or [[holm oaks]] groves, fallows and rocky areas in basal and montane floors.<ref name="iberica" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Aristolochia pistolochia L. |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/1aristolochia+pistolochia |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>
